_meta.description: All custom HubSpot contact properties required by the Dynasty Real Estate AI funnel. Run scripts/setup-hubspot.ts to create these automatically.

contactProperties.name: lead_type
contactProperties.label: Lead Type
contactProperties.description: Primary intent of this contact

contactProperties.label: Area(s) of Interest

contactProperties.name: budget_min
contactProperties.label: Budget Minimum ($)

contactProperties.label: Budget Maximum ($)

contactProperties.name: timeline

contactProperties.name: financing_status
